title: A bounded halting run produces the verdict
statement: For either Boolean mode, and for Boolean words $c$, $x$, and $z$ satisfying $z=	ext{dbl}(c)\,	ext{++}\,[0,1]$ followed by $x$, there is a time $t\le 12(|z|+1)^2$ at which the associated machine started on $z$ has halted and has output the singleton word containing its verdict on $z$.
hypotheses_covered: $z$ is the bitwise doubling of $c$, then $[0,1]$, then $x$
there exists a natural time $t$ within the stated bound
the machine is run from its initial configuration on $z$
the machine is halted at time $t$
the output at time $t$ is the singleton verdict word
